canDoYue: 你識過機場安檢：液體一百毫升以下放透明袋，電腦同行動電源攞出嚟，皮帶同手錶放盤，再問接駁車去閘口三十五。
canDoEn: At airport security, keep liquids under one hundred millilitres in a clear bag, take the laptop and power bank out, put the belt and watch in the tray, and ask for the shuttle to gate thirty-five.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hi. Are all of my liquids under one hundred millilitres?
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。我嘅液體係咪全部一百毫升以下？
dialogue.say: Hi. Are all of my liquids under one hundred millilitres?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. Those liquids in the clear bag are all fine.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。透明袋入面嘅液體冇問題。
dialogue.say: Yes. Those liquids in the clear bag are all fine.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Shouldn't the laptop and power bank come out of it?
dialogue.glossYue: 部手提電腦同行動電源係咪應該攞出嚟？
dialogue.say: Shouldn't the laptop and power bank come out of it?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. Take the laptop out and leave the charger.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。部電腦攞出嚟，充電器留低。
dialogue.say: Yes. Take the laptop out and leave the charger.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Do the belt and watch go in the tray?
dialogue.glossYue: 皮帶同手錶係咪放喺個盤？
dialogue.say: Do the belt and watch go in the tray?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. Both of those items go in the grey tray.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。兩樣都放喺灰色個盤。
dialogue.say: Yes. Both of those items go in the grey tray.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Thanks. Which way is gate thirty-five by the shuttle?
dialogue.glossYue: 多謝。閘口三十五搭接駁車點去？
dialogue.say: Thanks. Which way is gate thirty-five by the shuttle?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Yes. The blue shuttle train stops beside that far gate.
dialogue.glossYue: 係。藍色接駁車停喺嗰個閘口隔離。
dialogue.say: Yes. The blue shuttle train stops beside that far gate.
